title: Unbrewed Telemetry Deck Definitions v1
description: A batch of deck (hero) definitions pushed by a content producer to seed the versioned deck registry.

contentVersion.description: Optional producer content version stamped onto every deck in this batch.

rulesHash.description: Content-derived fingerprint of this deck's gameplay rules, '<algorithm>-<hex digest>' (for example fp1-9c3a17b40e21). Moves when card values, quantities, effect programs, hero/sidekick stats, or matched card titles move; stable across art, flavor, name, and tier changes. Optional: decks pushed without it keep their hand-set version as the only identity.

rulesCanonical.description: The exact canonical rules string that `rulesHash` digests, as produced by the engine's canonicalDeckRules(hero, cards). Archived verbatim so two fingerprints can be diffed rather than only distinguished. When present alongside a rulesHash whose algorithm this service knows, ingest recomputes the digest over these exact bytes and rejects a mismatch; an unknown algorithm prefix is stored unverified.
